---
description: 'Use when editing README files or other Markdown documentation. Covers concise project documentation and keeping instructions aligned with the implementation.'
applyTo: '**/*.md'
---

# Markdown Guidelines

- Keep documentation concise, task-oriented, and consistent with the current project behavior and package scripts.
- Use fenced code blocks with an appropriate language identifier for commands and code examples.
- Update existing documentation when possible instead of duplicating the same setup or command instructions in multiple places.
- Do not claim that features, tests, or integrations exist unless they are present and verified in the repository.
